question: The term ‘Mini Constitution’ is used for which Constitutional Amendment Act of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Mini Constitution"** was used for the **42nd Amendment Act 1976** because it brought about significant changes and additions to the Constitution, including the insertion of fundamental duties and the extension of emergency provisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **38th Amendment Act of 1975** brought in the following changes:
